notes.title: Now with +1
notes.content:
Yesterday a miracle happened and Cute Cats received the status of a full-fledged game!
The game now gives +1 in the application.
And in the near future you will be pleased with the loss of collectible cards.

Thank you to each and everyone for your support! Almost 5 years have passed since the last cards were received (Hentai Shooter 3D). I would like to believe that it will take less time before this game, which will receive +1, and the cards. Thanks again!

notes.title: New pricing and Steam Deck compatibility.
notes.content:
Due to a change in Steam's pricing policy, it has been decided to set prices for all games and DLC to $0.99. All future products will also be released at this price (if there are no new surprises).

Also today, games 5.0 and 6.0 were tested and received official Steam Deck support.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132070/50/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1165860/60/
